freeze_policy: Account mathematics, event semantics, Unitized NAV, TWR/XIRR, settlement, execution accounting and pending cancellation accounting cannot be changed under this contract version.

layers.recommendation: immutable strategy suggestion; never an account event
layers.account_state: changed only by reported, confirmed and settled real events

identity: TotalWealth = F + C + R + open Pending + SubscriptionPending + RedemptionReceivable - Payable

execution.recommended_amount: strategy/audit field only; prohibited as account balance input
execution.direction_mismatch: reject ACTION_MISMATCH; no manual override in v4.0
execution.same_direction_over_recommendation: allowed within available cash/redeemable units; mark execution_deviation

buy.decomposition: cash_debited = principal + fee when fee is known
buy.unknown_fee: fee remains null/UNKNOWN; provisional principal equals cash_debited until confirmation
buy.report_effect: C -> PENDING_SUBSCRIPTION using actual cash only

sell.report_effect: reserve redeemable units; do not invent cash
sell.settle_effect: REDEMPTION_RECEIVABLE -> C or explicit external payment

execution.correction: future immutable EXECUTION_CORRECTION referencing the original event; no UPDATE

pending.external_math: P -= W; Units -= W/NAV_before; external XIRR withdrawal; NAV/HWM unchanged
pending.reserve_math: P -= W; R += W; no external flow; Units/NAV/HWM unchanged
pending.partial: multiple distinct event_ids may reduce remaining_amount; never below zero
pending.history: original contribution is immutable and always retained

idempotency.signal: one active execution per official_signal_id even when event_id differs
idempotency.transaction: event, engine state and projections commit atomically

ordering: confirmation and settlement at their real effective times

migration.legacy_execution: retain V3 recommended-target account effect without recomputation
migration.version_default: events without version are V3 legacy
